text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, it's still too early for training. 
What should I do—

text_block_list.name: Comedian
text_block_list.text:
We're holding a comedy show on the stage 
over that way! Come check it out if you'd 
like!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Ooh, that sounds fun! I'm in, I'm in!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Dahaha! Oh yeah, you always get old guys 
like that!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Talk about an ultra-specific situation! 
Though I swear I've seen it before!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Haaah!? Wait, wait, was that whole clerk 
bit just a setup!?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
No way, nobody actually does that! Dammit, 
wasn't that supposed to be a relatable 
thing?!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Haha, my abs hurt from laughing so much! 
You guys have great taste!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: "Wait, crap! We're way past the time...!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Jungle Pocket got so absorbed in listening 
to the stand-up comedy show that she 
unintentionally ended up skipping her 
training.
